content.value_statement: Complex repository structure makes features and data flows difficult to trace. This skill maps Empathy Ledger files, services, routes, schemas, and dependencies.
actual_capabilities: Locate documented database type files by domain and identify associated tables.
Explain the documented flow from React components through API routes and services to Supabase.
Map core services, API routes, and components for a requested feature.
Describe documented tenant isolation and role hierarchy patterns.
Present findings with file references, relationship summaries, snippets, and simple diagrams.
limitations: The reference paths are specific to the Empathy Ledger repository.
The skill does not execute application code or verify runtime behavior by itself.
Documentation may become outdated when the repository changes.
Security and correctness conclusions require direct review of current implementation and tests.

use_cases.title: Learn the repository structure
use_cases.description: Find the main files, services, routes, types, and tables for an unfamiliar Empathy Ledger feature.

use_cases.title: Trace a feature flow
use_cases.description: Follow a user action across components, API routes, services, Supabase clients, and database tables.

use_cases.title: Review architecture boundaries
use_cases.description: Map tenant isolation, role hierarchy, service ownership, and dependencies before planning a change.

prompt_templates.title: Locate a feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Find where story consent is implemented. List the relevant routes, services, types, and database tables, then explain how they connect.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for a first repository lookup.

prompt_templates.title: Trace a data flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Trace a story creation request from the React component to PostgreSQL. Include each file, boundary, and tenant isolation check you can verify.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this to understand an end-to-end workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Compare related workflows
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare distribution, revocation, and consent workflows. Identify shared services, policy checks, persistence tables, and important differences.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this before changing related business logic.

prompt_templates.title: Build an architecture map
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an architecture map for project transcripts. Verify API, service, Supabase, schema, tenant, and role boundaries. Mark assumptions and missing evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for a detailed technical review.

output: Related storage includes consent proofs and story distribution records.

output_examples.input: How does a browser action reach the database?
output: A React component sends a request to an API route.
The API route calls the service layer.
The service uses a Supabase client to access PostgreSQL with row-level security.

output_examples.output: Queries obtain the current profile tenant and add a tenant_id filter before accessing tenant-scoped records.

best_practices: Ask about one feature or flow at a time.
Request direct file evidence and clearly marked assumptions.
Verify documented paths and behavior against the current repository before making changes.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the quick reference as a substitute for reading implementation code.
Do not assume every query has correct tenant filtering without verification.
Do not expose secrets or private data while sharing codebase findings.

faq.question: Which repository does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers the documented Empathy Ledger repository structure and conventions.

faq.question: Can it modify source files?
faq.answer: The skill is designed for exploration and explanation. Any code changes require separate instructions and review.

faq.question: Does it run the listed shell commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. The commands are documentation examples for locating files and references.

faq.question: Are the documented paths always current?
faq.answer: No. Repository changes can make paths or architecture notes outdated, so verify them against the current branch.

faq.question: Can it perform a complete security audit?
faq.answer: No. It can map security-relevant boundaries, but a complete audit requires implementation review, configuration review, and testing.

faq.question: What output formats does it support?
faq.answer: It can provide file references, relationship summaries, selected snippets, Markdown tables, and simple ASCII diagrams.
